# p10k-rs v0.2.2 — DRAFT

> Status: **draft** — pending Sean's review. Replace this banner
> and tag when ready. The release workflow fires on
> `git push origin v0.2.2`.

**The "`verify --json`" release.** Completes the
diagnostic-JSON trilogy: all three diagnostic subcommands
(`daemon-health`, `version`, `verify`) now offer structured
machine-readable output under the same `--json` convention.

**Test count:** +5 over v0.2.1 from the new JSON shape tests.
**Slice count:** 1 commit.
**Theme:** "scripting symmetry, complete."

## What you'll notice (visible changes)

### `p10k-rs verify --json`

Pass `--json` to emit a single-line JSON object instead of the
one-line text form. Same exit codes (0/2/3/4), same outcomes:

| Outcome | JSON |
|---------|------|
| Match | `{"status":"OK","triple":"<t>","version":"<v>","sha_prefix":"<12hex>"}` |
| Mismatch | `{"status":"MISMATCH","expected":"<64hex>","got":"<64hex>"}` |
| Not found | `{"status":"NOT_FOUND","reason":"<escaped>"}` |
| Unsupported arch | `{"status":"UNSUPPORTED_ARCH","triple":"<t>"}` |

```sh
# branch on structured field instead of parsing the text form
status=$(p10k-rs verify --json | jq -r .status)
case "$status" in
  OK)               ;;
  MISMATCH)         echo "supply-chain alert: gitstatusd hash mismatch" ;;
  NOT_FOUND)        echo "gitstatusd not installed at expected path" ;;
  UNSUPPORTED_ARCH) echo "host arch not in the pin table" ;;
esac
```

`reason` strings get the same JSON-escape pattern as the other
two subcommands (quote, backslash, C0 controls; non-ASCII UTF-8
passes through). No new dependencies.

The text format (default) is unchanged from v0.2.1 — SECURITY.md
still references it as the verification recipe.

### Diagnostic-JSON trilogy complete

All three diagnostic subcommands now offer the same
text-default-with-`--json`-for-machine-consumers convention:

| Subcommand | Text shipped | JSON shipped |
|---|---|---|
| `daemon-health` | v0.1.8 | v0.1.10 |
| `version` | v0.2.0 | v0.2.1 |
| `verify` | T0.5 (v0.1.5) | **v0.2.2** |

Same exit codes in either mode. Same wire-stability discipline
(additive field changes only in future releases; existing fields
keep their names and types).

## Security posture (no surface changes)

- **No new dependencies.** Hand-rolled JSON-escape pattern
  remains the right call for these bounded surfaces. Three
  copies of a ~15-line function across `daemon_health.rs`,
  `verify.rs`, and `main.rs` — considered factoring into a
  shared module but kept local; an abstraction for three call
  sites this small is premature.
- **No new `unsafe`.**
- **`cargo deny check` clean** (per-PR gate from v0.1.9).
- **JSON injection-safe.** Every string field that could carry
  untrusted content (`reason` in `NotFound`, error messages)
  passes through the escape encoder. The two structural JSON
  characters can't break out of the string context.

## Slice ledger

One commit on top of v0.2.1.

## Upgrading

```sh
git pull
./install.sh
```

No config-file migration. Scripts using the text-format
`verify` output continue to work unchanged; `--json` is opt-in.
